description: Multimmit consensus health, leader and producer-chain progress, certificate formation, protocol backpressure, and runtime network bandwidth.

panels.description: Number of Multimmit voters currently scraped.
panels.title: Reporting Nodes

panels.description: Difference between the fastest and slowest leader view, with each node's last sample extrapolated to now by the slope of its current view (raw samples are scraped up to one interval apart, which reads as false spread at high view rates).
panels.title: Leader View Spread

panels.description: Producer chains finalized below the highest finalized chain, worst node.
panels.title: Lagging Chains

panels.description: Fatal voter events during the selected dashboard range.
panels.title: Fatal Events

panels.description: Fleet-wide leader-view timeout rate.
panels.title: View Timeouts/s

panels.description: Block validations the application ended without a verdict.
panels.title: Unavailable Validations/s

panels.description: Newest view whose resolution facts were reported, highest across the selected nodes.
panels.title: Last Resolved View

panels.description: Current leader-chain view on every selected voter.
panels.title: Current Leader View

panels.description: Leader views per second, derived from the slope of each node's current view.
panels.title: Leader Views/s

panels.description: Average wall time per leader-chain view, derived from the reciprocal of the same one-minute current-view slope as Leader Views/s.
panels.title: View Latency

panels.description: Newest view whose resolution facts were reported on every selected node. Flat means resolution has stopped.
panels.title: Last Resolved View

panels.description: Lowest locally accepted height (dissemination laggard) and lowest height-quorum height (endorsement laggard) across producer chains.
panels.title: Chain Accepted and Quorum Floors

panels.description: Distance between the current view and the newest resolved view on each node.
panels.title: Resolution Lag

panels.description: Durable consensus publications awaiting successful transmission.
panels.title: Outstanding Publications

panels.description: Retained future-view artifacts. A full index starves view proofs that would move the node forward.
panels.title: Future Artifacts

panels.description: Whether the current view deadline is armed. Zero with a flat view means a halted voter.
panels.title: View Timer Armed

panels.description: Retired view floor on each node; its distance from the current view is retention depth.
panels.title: Retired View

panels.description: Final height of each producer chain on every selected node.
panels.title: Finalized Height

panels.description: Finalized height progress per producer chain.
panels.title: Producer Chain Progress/s

panels.description: Height of the newest locally produced header on each node. Flat on a producer means local production has stalled.
panels.title: Locally Produced Headers

panels.description: Heights each producer chain is finalized below the highest finalized chain on the same node.
panels.title: Chain Finalization Lag

panels.description: Producer chains finalized below the highest finalized chain on each node; the fan-out of a stall.

panels.description: Retained artifacts plus local reservations against the configured capacity.
panels.title: Artifact Cache

panels.description: Safety-journal barriers appended and acknowledged per second.
panels.title: Journal Barrier Throughput

panels.description: Prefix-covering start_sync calls per second.
panels.title: Prefix Syncs/s

panels.description: Average barriers, events, and KiB covered by each prefix sync.

targets.expr: sum by (deployer_name, deployer_ip) (rate(engine_voter_driver_journal_appended_barriers_total{deployer_name=~"$deployer_name",deployer_region=~"$deployer_region"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (deployer_name, deployer_ip) (rate(engine_voter_driver_journal_start_syncs_total{deployer_name=~"$deployer_name",deployer_region=~"$deployer_region"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.000000001)

sum by (deployer_name, deployer_ip) (rate(engine_voter_driver_journal_appended_events_total{deployer_name=~"$deployer_name",deployer_region=~"$deployer_region"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (deployer_name, deployer_ip) (rate(engine_voter_driver_journal_start_syncs_total{deployer_name=~"$deployer_name",deployer_region=~"$deployer_region"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.000000001)

sum by (deployer_name, deployer_ip) (rate(engine_voter_driver_journal_appended_bytes_total{deployer_name=~"$deployer_name",deployer_region=~"$deployer_region"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1024 / clamp_min(sum by (deployer_name, deployer_ip) (rate(engine_voter_driver_journal_start_syncs_total{deployer_name=~"$deployer_name",deployer_region=~"$deployer_region"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.000000001)

panels.title: Prefix Sync Coverage

panels.description: p99 and observed maximum barriers covered by one prefix sync.
panels.title: Covered Prefix Depth p99 / Max

panels.description: p99 time from journal append to durable prefix acknowledgement.
panels.title: Barrier Durability Latency p99

panels.description: p99 time from urgent tail append to its covering prefix sync start.
panels.title: Urgent Tail Sync Latency p99

panels.description: Pending barriers split into the in-flight covered prefix and uncovered tail.
panels.title: Pending Journal Barriers

panels.description: Canonical pending, uncovered, and observed maximum unsynced bytes.
panels.title: Pending Journal Bytes

panels.description: Observed maximum age of the oldest journal barrier when its prefix sync starts.
panels.title: Maximum Unsynced Age

panels.description: Bytes per second successfully received by the runtime network used by consensus.
panels.title: Runtime Inbound Bandwidth

panels.description: Bytes per second successfully sent by the runtime network used by consensus.
panels.title: Runtime Outbound Bandwidth

panels.description: Consensus message copies accepted by the runtime network, split by physical plane.
panels.title: Outbound Consensus Messages/s

panels.description: Encoded consensus bytes accepted by the runtime network, split by physical plane and recipient copy.
panels.title: Outbound Consensus Bandwidth

panels.description: Views a valid vote update trails this node's current view when the voter applies its verdict, so time spent queued for or inside the verification pool counts. Peers that fall behind and local verification backlog show up as a growing upper tail.
panels.title: Verified Vote Lag

panels.description: Views resolved by determination from n-f final votes without an L-QC, and views resolved by an L-QC pinning them.
panels.title: Views Resolved/s

panels.description: Producer headers accepted by adoption without a local body verdict. A sustained rate means bodies reach this node more slowly than endorsements do.
panels.title: Adopted Headers/s

panels.description: Self-certifying V-QC and L-QC view proofs classified before verification, by source and outcome. Rejections are the wedge alarm.
panels.title: View Proof Admissions/s

panels.description: Ingress hand-off to voter ingestion of one observation cohort.
panels.title: Observation Wait

panels.description: Network receipt to voter hand-off of one artifact.
panels.title: Ingress Dwell

panels.description: Queue wait of view-critical (fast) and bulk verification jobs.
panels.title: Verification Queue Wait

panels.description: Critical-pool submission to worker entry for local signing and certificate assembly.
panels.title: Crypto Submit Wait

panels.description: Dense finalized outputs durably committed to marshal storage per second, averaged across the selected fleet.
panels.title: Finalized Block Throughput

panels.description: Time from batch submission to the first local consensus finality covering the block, including queueing, body construction, custody, and signing.
panels.title: Proposal Finalization Latency

panels.description: Time from batch submission to delivery in the total order, including the wait for marshal to collect ordering proofs and read the block.
panels.title: Proposal Ordering Latency

panels.description: Time from scheduled batch submission to protocol finalization, including input queueing.
panels.title: Input Finalization Latency

panels.description: Views from the one a local block header was signed in to the one whose finality first covers it. Zero means the block was final in the view it was produced in.
panels.title: Views from Signing to Finality

panels.description: Fraction of local blocks whose first finality comes from the view their header was signed in.
panels.title: Share Final in Signing View

panels.description: Median and p99 batch-submission-to-finality latency divided by the mean view length. Defined from metrics both the counted-views and the original Multimmit export, so the two can be compared directly.
panels.title: Finalization Latency in Views

panels.description: Time from scheduled batch submission to the start of block construction.
panels.title: Input Queue Latency

panels.description: Views this node sent its final vote for, by why the view ended: Count (every chain filled its window), Bound (t_max passed, rule iii), Declared (another declaration rule).
panels.title: View Ends/s by Reason

panels.description: Fraction of views ending for each reason. Healthy views end on Count.
panels.title: View-End Share

panels.description: Mean time from view entry to this node's final vote, per node.

targets.expr: sum by (deployer_name, deployer_ip) (rate(engine_voter_view_end_millis_total{deployer_name=~"$deployer_name",deployer_region=~"$deployer_region"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (deployer_name, deployer_ip) (rate(engine_voter_view_ends_total{deployer_name=~"$deployer_name",deployer_region=~"$deployer_region"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Mean View Length

panels.description: Chains declared final, by rule: Stopped (i), Late (ii), Bound (iii), ViewChange (iv), Split (v), Grace (optimisation A), SilentLeader (optimisation B).
panels.title: Declarations/s by Rule

panels.description: One-way delay estimate the current view's timers derive from, per node.
panels.title: Measured Delay (delta_hat)

panels.description: Per-block production interval estimate (median across chains) the current view's timers derive from, per node.
panels.title: Measured Production Interval (theta_hat)

panels.description: The current view's grace for a leader proposal, per node.
panels.title: Grace (t_grace)

panels.description: Share of wall time the local producer was due to build but held by the flow bound D above the greater of h* and its final height, per node. A hold is recorded when it ends. A correct producer at theta stays far below the bound, so the series stays near zero.
panels.title: Producer Held Share (flow bound)

panels.description: Mean length of one hold of the local producer by the flow bound, per node.
panels.title: Mean Producer Hold

panels.description: Time from queueing a verification job for workers until the voter applies its verdicts, view-critical (fast) and bulk, per node.
panels.title: Verification Dwell p99

panels.description: Per-view wall time from entering a view to entering the next (engine_voter_round_latency), every view on every node; not sampled at 1 Hz.
panels.title: View Length per View (fleet)

panels.description: From this node entering a view to assembling its V-QC (engine_voter_vqc_latency).
panels.title: View Entry to V-QC (fleet)

panels.description: From this node entering a view to assembling the L-QC of its leader block (engine_voter_lqc_latency).
panels.title: View Entry to L-QC (fleet)

panels.description: Seconds per second the voter thread spends applying each input kind and executing its capabilities, mean per node (engine_voter_input_processing_sum). Summed with work, the busy fraction.
panels.title: Voter Thread Time by Input Kind

panels.description: Seconds per second the voter thread spends in machine work quanta by component, mean per node (engine_voter_work_processing_sum): pool = vote reading, chain = header acceptance, emission = sweep and resolution, view = declarations and votes.
panels.title: Voter Thread Time by Machine Component

panels.description: Share of wall time the voter thread spends in core service cycles (engine_voter_busy_micros_total).
panels.title: Voter Busy Fraction

panels.description: p99 of one core step per input kind (engine_voter_input_processing).
panels.title: Input Processing p99 by Kind

panels.description: p99 of one machine work quantum per component (engine_voter_work_processing).
panels.title: Work Processing p99 by Component

panels.description: Admission into the core to the completing step, by lane (engine_voter_input_wait), and ingress hand-off to voter ingestion (engine_voter_observation_wait). Subtract from the own-block round trip to separate delta_hat into network and local queueing.
panels.title: Voter Queueing

panels.description: Views resolved by n - f final votes (case b), by an L-QC pin (case a), and pins after n - f or more finals failed to determine the view.
panels.title: Boundary Resolution/s

panels.description: Chains the final votes left undetermined at boundaries pinned after a failed determination: unresolved = headers missing, split = no n - f tips share a reach.
panels.title: Undetermined Chains per Pinned Boundary

panels.description: Chains declared final per node by rule and by what the node knew: capped tip, silent for D_stop, ready header held back by the acceptance bounds (engine_voter_declaration_contexts_total).
panels.title: Declarations/s by Context

panels.description: Mean time since the declared chain last showed life, per rule (engine_voter_declaration_silence_millis_total / engine_voter_declarations_total). Rule (i) is at least D_stop by construction.
panels.title: Mean Silence at Declaration

panels.description: Ready peer headers refused by the flow bound D or the finality bound D + N, once per chain and height, mean per node (engine_voter_flow_refusals_total, engine_voter_finality_refusals_total). Nonzero on healthy chains means D binds producers.
panels.title: Acceptance Refusals/s

panels.description: Consensus bytes accepted by the network per node, by artifact kind, retries included (engine_voter_artifact_transmitted_bytes_total), and engine resolver responses (engine_resolver_served_bytes_total).
panels.title: Outbound Bytes/s by Artifact

panels.description: Consensus messages accepted by the network per node, by artifact kind (engine_voter_artifact_transmissions_total), and engine resolver responses.
panels.title: Outbound Messages/s by Artifact

panels.description: Encoded size of each published vote update and each locally assembled V-QC and L-QC.
panels.title: Encoded Sizes

panels.description: Exact body fetches marshal started, by obligation, per node; Adoption and AdoptedSubscription are fetches caused by adopting a header at tau endorsements. Adoption fetches avoided are deferred fetches whose body arrived within the grace.
panels.title: Body Fetches/s by Reason

panels.description: Bytes resent by publication retries per node (engine_voter_retransmitted_bytes_total).
panels.title: Retransmitted Bytes/s by Plane

panels.description: From a batch block header being signed to the first consensus finality covering it (application_proposal_signed_finalization_latency).
panels.title: Signed to First Finality

panels.description: From a batch block header being signed to its delivery in the total order (application_proposal_signed_ordering_latency).
panels.title: Signed to Ordered

panels.description: Share of batch blocks first final within 2 delta_hat + eta of their signature, the threshold taken at signing (application_proposal_goal_met_total / application_proposal_goal_finalized_total).
panels.title: Share Final within 2 delta_hat + eta

panels.description: Tracked batches evicted before first finality or before ordering, and tracked batches without observed finality. Any eviction is a measurement loss, not a protocol result.
panels.title: Latency Tracking Losses
